The main takeaway from our work is that
the hyphal transcriptional factor signalling mutants are attenuated in their virulence, and this attenuation is associated with reduced capacity to infect orogastric (tongue/oesophagus) tissues.
Tgepsilon26 is a good model of candidiasis in immunocompromised humans and that the hyphal transcription factors, Efg1 and Cph1, play an important role in the pathogenesis of candidiasis.
the Tgepsilon 26 mouse is a useful model for investigating the pathobiology of Candida infection in the absence of adaptive immune responses.
